title: Character position (superscript/subscript) — UI dropdown + SWF emit for single-run text
description: Flash 8 text Properties-panel parity. The character-position dropdown (Normal | Superscript | Subscript) maps to the characterPosition field (0/1/2), which ALREADY exists on TextDisplayObject and IS decoded from FLA, but: (a) the PropertiesPanel TextView does not expose it, and (b) the SWF compiler only encodes super/subscript for MULTI-RUN HTML fields (sup/sub tags) — single-run static/dynamic fields with characterPosition other than 0 drop it. Add: (1) UI dropdown in TextView. (2) compile: for single-run fields with characterPosition set, emit the appropriate baseline shift (HTML sup/sub wrapping with HTML flag, or adjusted YOffset/TextHeight in the DefineText TEXTRECORD). Acceptance: a superscript field round-trips and renders raised/smaller in Ruffle.
